THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/MH/07. Land Min.’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB/234.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the State intends to acquire the land described below to maintain a water reserve in the abandon paddy land in either side of Nugegoda Canal located between Old Kesbewa Road and 117 Bus Route under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Thirty (30) allotments of land in Total Extent of 1.9041 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 to 30 in the Preliminary Plan No. 9641 dated 25.05.2016 prepared by the Survey General, situated in the Villages called Divulpitiya and Pepiliyana in the Grama Niladhari Divisions No. 535 D of Divulpitiya East and No. 535 C of Pepiliyana East in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and morefully described as follows.
